finalText:
Done — dedup now tracks the last time something actually went out on a key, not just the last time it was seen. Before, a dropped repeat would still reset the 5-minute clock, so a burst of flaps close together could get stuck dropping forever. Now a drop doesn't count, so the next real send checks against the last delivery, not the last attempt.

`verify.js` still passes, and the full replay runs clean with no `route()` errors.
